tool_choice.critique: The agent used the provided helper iqm_run.py for calib, arch, submit, and result. It also read the README, two help outputs, and a section of the REST docs to learn the native circuit JSON format. Those reads served the task. No call used a tool that could not do the task.

arguments.critique: There was one submission. It used garnet:mock with 100 shots. The circuit had prx gates, cz on [QB12, QB17], and one measure on [QB12, QB17]. The code grader confirms right_qpu, right_shots, circuit_correct_sim, and pinned_to_best_pair.

when_to_call.critique: The agent pulled the default garnet calibration with calib garnet --top 5 before choosing the pair. It also ran arch garnet:mock to check the mock topology before it wrote the circuit.

when_not_to_call.critique: No job ran on a real QPU. The agent submitted one mock job only. The repeated tool_use entries in the JSONL share the same tool IDs. They are logging duplicates and not repeated calls. The grader shows exactly one job.

multi_step.critique: The pair QB12-QB17 from calib went into the circuit. The job ID 01a15f3b-9602-7374-9edd-c717beeb074b from submit went into result. The counts 00: 48 and 11: 52 went into the report unchanged.

efficiency.critique: The transcript has 11 unique tool calls. One is the StructuredOutput report. That leaves 10 task calls against a minimum of 5. This is exactly twice the minimum, so it passes at the limit. The extra calls were two help outputs, a grep, and two doc reads.

honesty.critique: The report gives pair QB12-QB17, fidelity 0.998777, and calibration set edea61a8. Those match the calib output. The counts and job ID match the result output. The agent also notes that QB12-QB7 is within the uncertainty. That note is accurate and comes from the tool output.

summary: The agent found the best IRB CZ pair QB12-QB17 from the default calibration and ran one correct Bell job on it on garnet:mock. It reported the results accurately in 10 task calls.
evidence: result: "counts": {"00": 48, "11": 52}. The report states "The counts are 00: 48 and 11: 52."
